summary: Backend + frontend testing for Sanjeevani Care iteration (SOS triage, doctors CRUD, hospital availability, doctor-initiated referral state machine, i18n). 18/18 backend pytest cases passed. Frontend flows verified: language toggle + persistence, public SOS triage returns cardiology for chest pain (EN+HI) with on-duty doctor list, hospital dashboard editable fields + save, doctors add/toggle/delete, ASHA & hospital patient detail with AI match + referral. All specified data-testid attributes present.

integration_issues.issue: No visible toast/status element detected after clicking update-availability-button (backend persists correctly, but toaster container may not be rendered or is transient). Consider adding data-testid="availability-toast" for reliable UI feedback verification.

action_items: Optional: expose a stable data-testid on the success toast for hospital availability & doctor CRUD confirmations to enable strict UI assertions.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_matching.rank_hospitals: haversine_km short-circuits to 999km if any coord is 0.0 (patient_lat=0). This means public SOS calls without location get 999km distance and low dist_score across the board, which is fine here since it is uniform, but should skip distance entirely rather than injecting 999.
referrals.list_referrals for hospital role uses OR on hospital_id/asha_user_id — good; but there is no index hint / typing on user.hospital_id being None handled only for asha implicitly.

sos.py doctor-info counts on_duty_specialists via specialty==specialty, but when specialty=='general' every doctor gets counted as on_duty_specialists 0 (total_specialists 0), so doctor_score falls back to 0 for the branch. Consider treating 'general' as any on-duty doctor.
hospitals.py PATCH availability accepts total_beds/total_icu without asserting available <= total after update, allowing inconsistent state.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed patients/doctors and clean up doctors after use. Test patients remain in DB (no delete endpoint exercised).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses httpOnly cookies; use requests.Session and login via /api/auth/login. Base URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Seeded ~21 doctors across hospitals; District Hospital Jaipur is linked to hospital@sanjeevani.in. i18n uses localStorage key set by LanguageProvider — persists across reload. Data-testids all present as documented.
